name: RSiliTech Simple Pricing
author: RSiliTech

sections.description:
RSiliTech Simple Pricing allows WooCommerce store owners to create role-based pricing rules. Apply custom prices or percentage discounts for different user roles like wholesale, VIP, or custom roles. Works with simple and variable products, categories, and tags.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic role-based pricing for WooCommerce
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • Dynamic role creation and discount management
  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Compatible with WooCommerce product categories and tags

Pro Version Features:

Upgrade to RSiliTech Simple Pricing Pro for advanced features:

  • Bulk/quantity discounts
  • Category-based pricing rules
  • Fixed price overrides
  • Priority-based role rules
  • Premium support and updates

For support and documentation, visit RSiliTech.com

Support

  • Website – https://www.rsilitech.com

  • Email – pluginsupport@rsilitech.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rsilitech-simple-pricing folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Simple Pricing to add user roles and set discounts.
sections.faq:
Can I apply different discounts to multiple roles?

Yes, you can create multiple roles and assign different discounts to each role.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin calculates the discount for variable products and displays it on the shop and product pages.

Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to function.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Translations are available in the Pro version. The free version is English-only.
